facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2013-0056 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 13 February 2013 following 2 recorded events in the archive, including INC-2013-014 and INC-2023-004. The change request record covers 5 clauses across 1 controlled document. The intent is to replace an existing requirement with one written to the current house style. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the critical safeguard set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are PRO-ELE-008.
